svg.title: iOS · Interval grading viewer · keyframed · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift (`phoneEditorBody`, `phoneTimelineCard`, `touchChrome`) with App/GradeTimelineView.swift in the card and App/PhotoAdjustmentsPanel.swift (layout .phone) below it, showing keyframed treatment 1e-A on the new controls (App/EditorControls/EditorToolChips.swift, XYPad.swift `PadReadouts` + `KeyframeDiamond`). Redrawn 2026-09-13 for the editor controls redesign — board 6a exactly: the strip has moved from between the media and a scrolling slider stack into a card over the picture's foot, directly above the sheet, and the Light sheet replaces the White Balance / Light cards. The strip is drawn ONLY for a capture with length to grade across (`hasTimeline`); a Photo capture gets project-photo.viewer.portrait.svg. LAYOUT (2a / 6a, `phoneEditorBody`): the picture fills the safe area (59 top / 34 bottom on this canvas) and is fitted into it — a 3:4 portrait shoot spans the width and centres vertically, 176…700 — and everything else floats over it. `touchChrome`: the 36 pt back disc at (16, 71) and the `EditorTabPill` top-right (right 16, top 74: 12 pt of vertical padding under the safe area, the 30 pt pill centred on the 36 pt disc) — the boards draw both at top 60, the app sits them 11 pt lower. The pill is rgba(28,28,30,.85) over material, radius 18, 12 pt semibold, the selected tab amber with black text, the rest amber on ink; Frames appears only on a shoot with more than one frame. The foot (`phoneFoot`) is bottom-anchored on the safe area: the timeline card where `hasTimeline`, then EITHER the six main buttons (`EditorGroupBar(.phone)`) OR the open group's sheet (`PhotoAdjustmentsPanel(layout: .phone)`) — one or the other, the sheet needs the buttons' room. The sheet: 22 pt top corners, rgba(28,28,30,.86) over material running under the home indicator, padded 12 top / 16 sides / 0 bottom, 10 pt between rows, shadow up; header = title 15 pt semibold white · 6 pt dot (accent when the group holds a value or a travelling field, clear otherwise so the row never reflows) · spacer · ✕ 32 pt white 10 % (reverts to the snapshot `openPanel(for:)` took) · ✓ 32 pt amber (keeps and closes). Long-press the title for Reset <group> / Reset all adjustments. The 1:1 toggle (`zoomControls`, 32 pt black 45 %) sits bottom-trailing of the picture pane 12 pt in, lifted above the foot by its measured height; it exists only while `hasPixelsToReveal`, so a small source shows none. The readouts print the app's own formats (`%+.2f`, `%+.0f`, unsigned 0…100, Kelvin) with an ASCII hyphen-minus where the boards typeset U+2212. THE CARD (6a, `phoneTimelineCard`): margins 12 / 12 / 8 below, padding 10 / 12 / 6, radius 16, black 60 % over material — the `EditorMarqueeBadge` (INTERVAL · 2 h 14 min · 58 frames: 20 pt, black 50 %, 11 pt semibold) then, 20 pt under it, the strip on its full metrics, unchanged from the earlier placement: 30 pt play control (#1C1C1E disc, amber play.fill), 12 pt gap, a 3 pt rail at white 18 %, 11 pt amber moments with a 2 pt #C36A00 ring at 10 / 52 / 86 %, a 3×22 white playhead at 30 % UNDER the moments, the elapsed bubble (16 pt, #2B2B2E 90 %, 10 pt semibold '0:40:12') held between 7 % and 93 % of the track, its foot over the playhead's head; h:mm:ss at both ends in 10.5 pt #8E8E93 (the format is chosen from the whole span); and the two 30 pt one-frame steps ‹ › 8 pt apart after the track, taking their width out of it — centred on the strip's whole 45 pt (30 + 2 + 13), 7.5 pt below the play disc. Nothing on the card is clipped: the bubble and a moment's delete affordance float above its top edge. STATES NOT DRAWN, all from the same component: SNAPPED — tapping a moment lands the playhead on it and the dot swells to 15 pt, white inside a 1.5 pt #C36A00 halo, and the pads then edit THAT moment; LONG-PRESS — 550 ms on a moment raises a #2B2B2E bubble with 'Delete Keyframe' in #FF6B5E; a step that would fall off an end is disabled and drops its chevron to #8E8E93 at 45 % (see the first-run file). THE PANEL (1e-A on the new controls): a tool chip carries the 7 pt diamond (amber on a #C36A00 hairline, rotated 45°) after its label when EITHER of its fields travels — Exp · Con for exposure, High · Wh for highlights; a readout whose field travels carries the diamond between label and value and prints in the accent — Exposure ◆ -0.09 is the value at THIS moment (the smoothstep between the moments at 10 % and 52 %), not a value for the clip; Contrast has no diamond because no moment moves it. A group holding a travelling field is never neutral, so the title keeps its dot and the main button its dot. Double-tap the pad → `onResetField` for both fields (each property comes OUT of the moment); ✕ restores the whole snapshot — preset, adjustments, TIMELINE, preset state and white-balance source — through the same binding. MODEL, unchanged: moments are positions in the SOURCE, 0…1 (GradeTimeline); between two the grade is their smoothstep blend, outside them the nearest holds; the stored PhotoAdjustments mirror the opening moment; a keyframed grade is always Edited; Temp and Tint are ABSOLUTE and keyframed like every other field (2026-09-06). Staged by LL_EDITOR=latest LL_VIEWER=1 LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=light:expcon. The hook writes exposure, highlights, shadows, vibrance and an owned white at 10 / 52 / 86 % (6100 K → 7600 K → 5400 K), so a screenshot also shows a diamond on Shad · Bl and, in Color, on WB and Vib · Sat — staging data, not layout; this file keeps board 6a's two. The reference shoot read 6 min 4 s · 183 frames with a 1:50 bubble; the boards' 2 h 14 min · 58 frames and 0:40:12 / 2:14:00 are kept.
svg.text: iOS · Interval grading viewer · keyframed · portrait · 393×852 pt
mirrors PhotoViewerView + GradeTimelineView + PhotoAdjustmentsPanel(.phone) — card + Light sheet · LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=light:expcon
